acceptance: Visual coherence plus behavioral coherence: the same state means the same thing everywhere; the user does not relearn system semantics on each surface.
component_rule: A component that cannot connect to real capability must not masquerade as live functionality.
consistency_rule: Prefer canonical tokens and components; a genuinely necessary new primitive documents why it cannot reuse an existing one and how it fits the established language.
purpose: The design-system doctrine of the activation kit: the system objective, the component contract, the consistency rule, and what acceptance means.
system_objective: A reusable language for structure, typography, spacing, surfaces, states, icons, motion and components — preventing every screen from becoming a separate design experiment.
title: DESIGN / DESIGN SYSTEM
